reference.title: Mermaid diagrams
reference.becomes: A diagram drawn by Mermaid, shown as a picture in the editor's light or dark theme. A diagram with a mistake shows Mermaid's message. Its pencil, or the cursor, opens its source.

reference.title: VitePress contents lists

git's conflict markers
cases.example:
<<<<<<< HEAD
Budget: 4,200, agreed with Dana on the 12th.
=======
Budget: 4,500.
>>>>>>> north-wall
cases.view: Merge conflictCurrent change (HEAD)Budget: 4,200, agreed with Dana on the 12th.Incoming change (north-wall)Budget: 4,500.Resolve in Source
cases.off:
<<<<<<< HEAD
Budget: 4,200, agreed with Dana on the 12th.
Budget: 4,500.
north-wall

reference.title: Git's conflict markers
reference.becomes: A merge conflict, its two sides labeled with the names git gave them. Its lines are not read as markdown, where the line above `=======` would become a heading. In the Rich editor, three buttons keep one side or both. A link opens the note in Source at the conflict.
